summary: Travel style quiz app with Instagram story sharing feature
architectural_notes: Travel style quiz generates personalized Instagram story images
Admin can upload base images per travel style for Instagram stories
Text overlay system uses Gotham Medium font, centered positioning

existing_features.title: Add image upload capability in the admin panel Travel Style Quiz section, allowing admins to upload one Instagram story base image per travel style archetype
Generate Instagram story image by overlaying travel style name and description centered on the uploaded base image using Gotham Medium font when a user completes the travel style quiz
Display the generated Instagram story image in the first tile of the quiz results page, allowing users to download and share it on Instagram

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin panel: Upload Instagram story images per travel style in Travel Style Quiz section
Generate Instagram story with uploaded image + centered text overlay (travel style name + description) using Gotham Medium font when quiz is completed
Display generated Instagram story image in first tile of quiz results for users to download and share
